responsibility: Defines the central per-function data structures and interfaces used during RTL expansion and later back-end processing. It declares emit and expression status records, RTL EH support state, register and stack-frame bookkeeping helpers, temporary-slot and stack-local allocation APIs, cfun/context push-pop operations, function start/end expansion hooks, prologue/epilogue utilities, and assorted helpers for parameter layout, block numbering, return emission, and post-compilation cleanup.
same_name_distinction: Defines the central per-function status structures and declares the APIs for function context, stack/frame allocation, expansion, and cleanup; unlike gcc/function.cc, it is the structural/interface definition rather than the implementation of cfun management and RTL-generation behavior.
